### Optimized Loki Critical & Error Logs

This dashboard uses LogQL raw string filters to avoid invalid escape errors and suppresses Grafana/Loki self-query noise, dashboard import logs, live-tail cancellations, Alloy throttling, and successful API request logs. **No data is healthy** for most panels.
